    Proposition 2.5: extending retractions by filtered colimits #

    Let Φ : D_fin → mod A have finite-dimensional values, and let ρ^fin be retractions for Φ on C_fin (Definition 2.4). Then the colimit extension F has retractions on C; if every composite of n maps in kernels of ρ^fin vanishes, the same holds for the new retractions.

    The retraction of f : F(X) → F(Y) is glued from the finite retractions of lifts Φ(T_{V₀}) → Φ(T_{V₁}) of f along the cofinal subrepresentations T_{V₀} of Lemma 2.2(3) (Kron.CompatFamily.glue).
